row.name: artefact_view
row.definition: select "ontology"."node_version"."id", "ontology"."node_version"."version", "ontology"."node_version"."action", "ontology"."node"."type", "ontology"."artefact_version"."caption", "ontology"."node_version"."timestamp", "version_zero"."timestamp" as "created_at" from "ontology"."artefact_version" inner join "ontology"."node_version" on (("ontology"."artefact_version"."id" = "ontology"."node_version"."id") and ("ontology"."artefact_version"."version" = "ontology"."node_version"."version")) inner join "ontology"."node" on "ontology"."artefact_version"."id" = "ontology"."node"."id" inner join "ontology"."node_version" "version_zero" on (("ontology"."artefact_version"."id" = "version_zero"."id") and ("version_zero"."version" = 0)) where ((not exists (select 1 from "ontology"."node_version" "newer" where (("newer"."id" = "ontology"."artefact_version"."id") and ("newer"."version" > "ontology"."artefact_version"."version")))) and (case "ontology"."node"."type" when 'printed' then exists (select 1 from "ontology"."printed_version" where (("ontology"."artefact_version"."id" = "ontology"."printed_version"."id") and ("ontology"."artefact_version"."version" = "ontology"."printed_version"."version")) offset 0) when 'digital' then exists (select 1 from "ontology"."digital_version" where (("ontology"."artefact_version"."id" = "ontology"."digital_version"."id") and ("ontology"."artefact_version"."version" = "ontology"."digital_version"."version")) offset 0) when 'ebook' then ((exists (select 1 from "ontology"."printed_version" where (("ontology"."artefact_version"."id" = "ontology"."printed_version"."id") and ("ontology"."artefact_version"."version" = "ontology"."printed_version"."version")) offset 0)) and (exists (select 1 from "ontology"."digital_version" where (("ontology"."artefact_version"."id" = "ontology"."digital_version"."id") and ("ontology"."artefact_version"."version" = "ontology"."digital_version"."version")) offset 0)) and (exists (select 1 from "ontology"."ebook_version" where (("ontology"."artefact_version"."id" = "ontology"."ebook_version"."id") and ("ontology"."artefact_version"."version" = "ontology"."ebook_version"."version")) offset 0))) else false end))

row.name: digital_view

row.name: ebook_view
row.definition: select "ontology"."node_version"."id", "ontology"."node_version"."version", "ontology"."node_version"."action", "ontology"."artefact_version"."caption", "ontology"."printed_version"."press_run", "ontology"."digital_version"."file_size", "ontology"."ebook_version"."drm", "ontology"."node_version"."timestamp", "version_zero"."timestamp" as "created_at" from "ontology"."ebook_version" inner join "ontology"."node_version" on (("ontology"."ebook_version"."id" = "ontology"."node_version"."id") and ("ontology"."ebook_version"."version" = "ontology"."node_version"."version")) inner join "ontology"."node" on "ontology"."ebook_version"."id" = "ontology"."node"."id" inner join "ontology"."artefact_version" on (("ontology"."ebook_version"."id" = "ontology"."artefact_version"."id") and ("ontology"."ebook_version"."version" = "ontology"."artefact_version"."version")) inner join "ontology"."printed_version" on (("ontology"."ebook_version"."id" = "ontology"."printed_version"."id") and ("ontology"."ebook_version"."version" = "ontology"."printed_version"."version")) inner join "ontology"."digital_version" on (("ontology"."ebook_version"."id" = "ontology"."digital_version"."id") and ("ontology"."ebook_version"."version" = "ontology"."digital_version"."version")) inner join "ontology"."node_version" "version_zero" on (("ontology"."ebook_version"."id" = "version_zero"."id") and ("version_zero"."version" = 0)) where not exists (select 1 from "ontology"."node_version" "newer" where (("newer"."id" = "ontology"."ebook_version"."id") and ("newer"."version" > "ontology"."ebook_version"."version")))
